candidates.title: Anthropic Becomes Most Valuable Private AI Startup After Major Funding Round
candidates.description: Reports confirmed Anthropic closed a major funding round, making it the most valuable private AI startup globally, surpassing OpenAI's previous valuation.

candidates.title: KPMG Deploys Anthropic's Claude to 276,000 Employees Worldwide
candidates.description: KPMG announced the deployment of Anthropic's Claude to its 276,000 employees across 138 countries, representing one of the largest "Big Four" AI enterprise deployments.

candidates.title: University of Illinois Researchers Announce Breakthrough in Monolithic 3D Chips for AI
candidates.description: Researchers at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) announced a major breakthrough in semiconductor technology with the successful development of monolithic 3D integrated chips using standard single-crystalline silicon, poised to address the "memory wall" limiting AI processing speeds.

candidates.title: Anthropic Forecasts First Profitable Quarter with Revenue Doubling to $10.9 Billion
candidates.description: Anthropic disclosed to investors that its revenue is projected to more than double to $10.9 billion in Q2 2026, putting the company on track for its first profitable quarter.
